verdict.rationale: Voice conversation is a fair question for a consumer AI assistant, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents voice input, speech output, or real-time spoken conversation in Kimi. The multimodal evidence covers only file, image, and video understanding, and the help topics list search, memory, agents, PPT and deep research, with no voice mode.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can have a natural, real-time voice conversation with the assistant
